prompt: A frame from a feature film set in the 1920s, shot on grainy 35mm colour film, the picture filling the frame edge to edge. Close on a leather-gloved hand and the round drum of a tommy gun held out of a speeding car window, the barrel pointed straight up at the night sky, rain striking the steel, the brim of a grey fedora at the edge of frame. Behind, the city streaks past as long-exposure light: streetlamps and the iron girders of an elevated railway smeared into bending ribbons of amber and red. The only light is the passing lamps sweeping across the gun. Thanks.
